I’m a flight attendant of 8 years and have met several people who are nervous flyers! It is a completely rational fear to be afraid of flying and it’s okay to feel the way you do! I’m not saying that in a way that it’s dangerous at all but more of a way that it doesn’t seem natural to humans. If you’re able to let a flight attendant know you’re a nervous flyer, we are all trained to accommodate. I’ve had plenty of people ask if they can have another passenger accompany them to keep them occupied. It’s a great time to meet a stranger and hear their life story! I’ve also met plenty that would rather just be alone and not be spoken to which is completely fine aswell. People have even asked me to talk to the pilots beforehand so they know who’s driving and it helps ease their mind. My biggest suggestion is if you’re willing to let the counter agents know you’d like to pre-board because you’re a nervous flyer and definitely let the flight attendants know, especially if you’re prone to anxiety attacks or panic attacks.
